title: The planes that didn't come back.
mechanism: Wald noticed that the count of bullet holes on returning planes is not the count of bullet holes on all planes — it is the count conditional on survival. He wanted the reverse: given a plane was hit at region R, what is the chance it survives? Bayes' theorem exchanges the two conditionals. When the observed hit rate at R among survivors is near zero, the posterior survival probability given a hit at R is near zero — so armor belongs there, not where the holes cluster.
